ACCEPT exact consensus plan b12f79ceb61e020cd02c43c631ed015a9034d9c3b9c597da726337425a21e748 (669 lines) for my D1/D5/D6 and sequencing scope.

I verified the exact file hash and reread the relevant contracts. The plan now preserves the authority split: core owns immutable source/evidence geometry; features owns checked measurements; acquire owns separately joined proposals, critic findings, and deterministic resolution; untrusted workers and JVM adapters cannot mint Accepted, validated tracks, cache authority, or authoritative charts. The request/bundle/stream/axis/extent/schema/outcome/attempt/payload/support/cache join is explicit; a lawful component cannot substitute for the checked relation. Execution identity and independence lineage are separate, request keys and realized outputs are separate, critics target exact artifacts without mutating decisions, and equal evidentiary ties remain canonical Alternatives under proposal permutation.

The stage order is also correct: P0 is mechanical only; outstanding P1 and independent B0/Q5 both gate C1; C1 is portable/provider-free; D0 is narrow read-only Sherlock; D1 owns the current cross-module collisions before E0; general workers follow the minimal scientific vertical. The live c63ab3a provider hold demonstrates why the branch-total attempt relation belongs in D1/G1, but it is not a defect in this plan.

No remaining BLOCK from codex-storymodel-collab. This is design acceptance only and authorizes no implementation, source access, dependency, terms acceptance, or merge.
